The corpus focuses on reproductive senescence, longevity, diet restriction, and trade-offs between growth/reproduction/aging. The closest, snippet [14], notes temporary reductions in individual growth rates and a shift to smaller individuals, but this concerns population size structure under resource fluctuation rather than individual shrinking at constant food, and does not bear clearly on the stylized fact. Snippets [12] and [6] discuss growth under feeding regimes but address lifespan and maturation rather than shrinking. No snippet provides evidence affirming or contradicting the absence of substantial shrinking at constant food independent of ageing. Evidence is therefore sparse/weak and effectively neutral with respect to the stylized fact.

No snippet contradicts the fact. Support is moderate—anchored largely by one direct DEB-theory statement plus a few consistent mentions—so evidence_strength is 2 with a corroborated consensus direction of 3.
